port.name: OpenCode
port.description: Living Code for OpenCode TUI: complete native JSON palettes for UI, Markdown, syntax highlighting, selections and review diffs.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/opencode.git
cd opencode
```

```sh
mkdir -p "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/opencode/themes"
cp themes/*.json "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/opencode/themes/"
```

Restart OpenCode and run `/theme`, then choose `living-code-night`. For project-only installation, copy the files into `.opencode/themes/` instead.
guide.configuration: The files use the OpenCode v1 `{ "theme": { … } }` JSON format. They provide every required color, explicit selected-item text and menu backgrounds. Every flavor is a separate theme, so Paper stays light even in a dark terminal. Put configuration in `tui.json`, not in the theme file; preserve any existing keybindings.
guide.compatibility: Targets the TUI theme format verified against OpenCode 1.19.0. This is not the web/desktop theme format. Truecolor gives the intended colors; reduced-color terminals approximate them. OpenCode 2 theme documents are a different API and are not claimed here. Syntax, Markdown and diff color contracts are checked independently of generation.
